pr_title: core/vm: make gas cost reporting to tracers correct
pr_body:
Supersedes #22680 

Original description below:

---

Possible way to close #22649.
Previously, the `makeCallVariantGasCallEIP2929` charged the cold account access cost directly, leading to an incorrect gas cost passed to the tracer from the main execution loop.
This change still temporarily charges the cost (to allow for an accurate calculation of the available gas for the call), but then afterwards refunds it and instead returns the correct total gas cost to be then properly charged in the main loop.

This is the best fix I could come up with that keeps the general wrapper structure intact. Alternatives would be deeper changes to the way EIP-2929 gas cost calculation is conducted.

issue_context.title: Incorrect gas cost passed to tracer for EIP-2929 calls with cold account accesses
comments: I will see if I can create a PR later today with a proposed fix that keeps the existing `makeCallVariantGasCallEIP2929` wrapper structure.

review_comments: Can we define another function which only does the check instead of charging directly? So that we don't need the "add it back" operation later.

That would be neat, however, it doesn't quite work. We need to actually remove the gas, so that when the `oldCalculator` calculates the `63/64ths`, it does so from the lower amount, not the higher amount.
